verses.original: וַיְהִי֙ אַחֲרֵי־ כֵ֔ן דָּוִ֛יד אֶת־ וַיַּ֥ךְ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים וַיַּכְנִיעֵ֑ם וַיִּקַּ֛ח אֶת־ גַּ֥ת וּבְנֹתֶ֖יהָ מִיַּ֥ד פְּלִשְׁתִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ’a·ḥă·rê- ḵên dā·wîḏ ’eṯ- way·yaḵ pə·liš·tîm way·yaḵ·nî·‘êm way·yiq·qaḥ ’eṯ- gaṯ ū·ḇə·nō·ṯe·hā mî·yaḏ pə·liš·tîm
verses.literal: Some time later . . . . . . David - defeated the Philistines subdued them and took - Gath and its villages from the hand of the Philistines

verses.original: וַיַּ֖ךְ אֶת־ מוֹאָ֑ב מוֹאָב֙ וַיִּהְי֤וּ עֲבָדִ֣ים לְדָוִ֔יד נֹשְׂאֵ֖י מִנְחָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yaḵ ’eṯ- mō·w·’āḇ mō·w·’āḇ way·yih·yū ‘ă·ḇā·ḏîm lə·ḏā·wîḏ nō·śə·’ê min·ḥāh
verses.literal: [David] also defeated - the Moabites and they became subject to David and brought him tribute

verses.original: חֲמָ֑תָה דָּוִ֛יד אֶת־ וַיַּ֥ךְ מֶֽלֶךְ־ הֲדַדְעֶ֥זֶר צוֹבָ֖ה בְּלֶכְתּ֕וֹ לְהַצִּ֥יב יָד֖וֹ פְּרָֽת׃ בִּֽנְהַר־
verses.transliteration: ḥă·mā·ṯāh dā·wîḏ ’eṯ- way·yaḵ me·leḵ- hă·ḏaḏ·‘e·zer ṣō·w·ḇāh bə·leḵ·tōw lə·haṣ·ṣîḇ yā·ḏōw pə·rāṯ bin·har-
verses.literal: [As far as] Hamath David - also defeated King Hadadezer of Zobah who had marched out to establish his dominion along the Euphrates River

verses.original: דָּוִ֨יד וַיִּלְכֹּד֩ מִמֶּ֜נּוּ אֶ֣לֶף רֶ֗כֶב וְשִׁבְעַ֤ת אֲלָפִים֙ פָּֽרָשִׁ֔ים וְעֶשְׂרִ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף אִ֣ישׁ רַגְלִ֑י וַיְעַקֵּ֤ר דָּוִיד֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ הָרֶ֔כֶב מֵ֥אָה מִמֶּ֖נּוּ וַיּוֹתֵ֥ר רָֽכֶב׃
verses.transliteration: dā·wîḏ way·yil·kōḏ mim·men·nū ’e·lep̄ re·ḵeḇ wə·šiḇ·‘aṯ ’ă·lā·p̄îm pā·rā·šîm wə·‘eś·rîm ’e·lep̄ ’îš raḡ·lî way·‘aq·qêr dā·wîḏ ’eṯ- kāl- hā·re·ḵeḇ mê·’āh mim·men·nū way·yō·w·ṯêr rā·ḵeḇ
verses.literal: David captured from him a thousand chariots seven thousand charioteers and twenty thousand vvv foot soldiers and he hamstrung . . . - all the horses except a hundred - he kept for the chariots

verses.original: אֲרַ֣ם דַּרְמֶ֔שֶׂק וַיָּבֹא֙ לַעְז֕וֹר מֶ֣לֶךְ לַהֲדַדְעֶ֖זֶר צוֹבָ֑ה דָּוִיד֙ בַּאֲרָ֔ם וַיַּ֤ךְ עֶשְׂרִֽים־ וּשְׁנַ֥יִם אֶ֖לֶף אִֽישׁ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·ram dar·me·śeq way·yā·ḇō la‘·zō·wr me·leḵ la·hă·ḏaḏ·‘e·zer ṣō·w·ḇāh dā·wîḏ ba·’ă·rām way·yaḵ ‘eś·rîm- ū·šə·na·yim ’e·lep̄ ’îš
verses.literal: When the Arameans of Damascus came to help King Hadadezer of Zobah David . . . struck down twenty-two . . . thousand of their men

verses.original: דָּוִיד֙ וַיָּ֤שֶׂם בַּאֲרַ֣ם דַּרְמֶ֔שֶׂק אֲרָם֙ וַיְהִ֤י עֲבָדִ֖ים לְדָוִ֔יד נֹשְׂאֵ֣י מִנְחָ֑ה יְהוָה֙ לְדָוִ֔יד וַיּ֤וֹשַׁע בְּכֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָלָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: dā·wîḏ way·yā·śem ba·’ă·ram dar·me·śeq ’ă·rām way·hî ‘ă·ḇā·ḏîm lə·ḏā·wîḏ nō·śə·’ê min·ḥāh Yah·weh lə·ḏā·wîḏ way·yō·wō·ša‘ bə·ḵōl ’ă·šer hā·lāḵ
verses.literal: Then he placed [garrisons] in Aram of Damascus and the Arameans became subject to David and brought him tribute So the LORD made David victorious wherever - he went

verses.original: דָּוִ֗יד אֵ֚ת וַיִּקַּ֣ח הַזָּהָ֔ב שִׁלְטֵ֣י אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָי֔וּ עַ֖ל עַבְדֵ֣י הֲדַדְעָ֑זֶר וַיְבִיאֵ֖ם יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: dā·wîḏ ’êṯ way·yiq·qaḥ haz·zā·hāḇ šil·ṭê ’ă·šer hā·yū ‘al ‘aḇ·ḏê hă·ḏaḏ·‘ā·zer way·ḇî·’êm yə·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: And David - took the gold shields that belonged to the officers of Hadadezer and brought them to Jerusalem

verses.original: וּמִטִּבְחַ֤ת וּמִכּוּן֙ עָרֵ֣י הֲדַדְעֶ֔זֶר דָּוִ֛יד לָקַ֥ח מְאֹ֑ד רַבָּ֣ה נְחֹ֖שֶׁת בָּ֣הּ׀ שְׁלֹמֹ֗ה אֶת־ עָשָׂ֣ה הַנְּחֹ֙שֶׁת֙ יָ֤ם וְאֶת־ הָֽעַמּוּדִ֔ים וְאֵ֖ת הַנְּחֹֽשֶׁת׃פ כְּלֵ֥י
verses.transliteration: ū·miṭ·ṭiḇ·ḥaṯ ū·mik·kūn ‘ā·rê hă·ḏaḏ·‘e·zer dā·wîḏ lā·qaḥ mə·’ōḏ rab·bāh nə·ḥō·šeṯ bāh šə·lō·mōh ’eṯ- ‘ā·śāh han·nə·ḥō·šeṯ yām wə·’eṯ- hā·‘am·mū·ḏîm wə·’êṯ han·nə·ḥō·šeṯ kə·lê
verses.literal: And from Tibhath and Cun cities of Hadadezer David took a large amount of bronze with which Solomon - made the bronze Sea - the pillars and [various] bronze articles

verses.original: מֶ֣לֶךְ תֹּ֖עוּ חֲמָ֑ת וַיִּשְׁמַ֕ע כִּ֚י דָוִ֔יד אֶת־ הִכָּ֣ה כָּל־ חֵ֖יל הֲדַדְעֶ֥זֶר מֶֽלֶךְ־ צוֹבָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: me·leḵ tō·‘ū ḥă·māṯ way·yiš·ma‘ kî ḏā·wîḏ ’eṯ- hik·kāh kāl- ḥêl hă·ḏaḏ·‘e·zer me·leḵ- ṣō·w·ḇāh
verses.literal: When King Tou of Hamath heard that David - had defeated the entire army of Hadadezer king of Zobah

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֣ח אֶת־ בְּנ֣וֹ הֲדֽוֹרָם־ אֶל־ לִשְׁאוֹל ל֨וֹ הַמֶּֽלֶךְ־ דָּ֠וִיד לְשָׁל֜וֹם וּֽלְבָרֲכ֗וֹ עַל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר נִלְחַ֤ם וַיַּכֵּ֔הוּ בַּהֲדַדְעֶ֙זֶר֙ כִּי־ אִ֛ישׁ הֲדַדְעָ֑זֶר הָיָ֣ה מִלְחֲמ֥וֹת תֹּ֖עוּ וְכֹ֗ל כְּלֵ֛י זָהָ֥ב וָכֶ֖סֶף וּנְחֹֽשֶׁת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·laḥ ’eṯ- bə·nōw hă·ḏō·w·rām- ’el- liš·ʾōl lōw ham·me·leḵ- dā·wîḏ lə·šā·lō·wm ū·lə·ḇā·ră·ḵōw ‘al ’ă·šer nil·ḥam way·yak·kê·hū ba·hă·ḏaḏ·‘e·zer kî- ’îš hă·ḏaḏ·‘ā·zer hā·yāh mil·ḥă·mō·wṯ tō·‘ū wə·ḵōl kə·lê zā·hāḇ wā·ḵe·sep̄ ū·nə·ḥō·šeṯ
verses.literal: he sent - his son Hadoram to greet - King David vvv and bless him for - fighting and defeating Hadadezer [who] . . . - had been at war with Tou [Hadoram brought] all kinds of articles of gold and silver and bronze

verses.original: גַּם־ הַמֶּ֤לֶךְ דָּוִיד֙ הִקְדִּ֞ישׁ אֹתָ֗ם לַיהוָ֔ה עִם־ הַכֶּ֙סֶף֙ וְהַזָּהָ֔ב אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָשָׂ֖א מִכָּל־ הַגּוֹיִ֑ם מֵֽאֱד֤וֹם וּמִמּוֹאָב֙ וּמִבְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֔וֹן וּמִפְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים וּמֵֽעֲמָלֵֽק׃
verses.transliteration: gam- ham·me·leḵ dā·wîḏ hiq·dîš ’ō·ṯām Yah·weh ‘im- hak·ke·sep̄ wə·haz·zā·hāḇ ’ă·šer nā·śā mik·kāl hag·gō·w·yim mê·’ĕ·ḏō·wm ū·mim·mō·w·’āḇ ū·mib·bə·nê ‘am·mō·wn ū·mip·pə·liš·tîm ū·mê·‘ă·mā·lêq
verses.literal: and King David dedicated these to the LORD along with the silver and gold - he had carried off from all [these] nations from Edom and Moab and from the Ammonites . . . Philistines and Amalekites

verses.original: וְאַבְשַׁ֣י בֶּן־ צְרוּיָ֗ה הִכָּ֤ה אֶת־ שְׁמוֹנָ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר אָֽלֶף׃ אֱדוֹם֙ בְּגֵ֣יא הַמֶּ֔לַח
verses.transliteration: wə·’aḇ·šay ben- ṣə·rū·yāh hik·kāh ’eṯ- šə·mō·w·nāh ‘ā·śār ’ā·lep̄ ’ĕ·ḏō·wm bə·ḡê ham·me·laḥ
verses.literal: Moreover, Abishai son of Zeruiah struck down - eighteen . . . thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt

verses.original: וַיָּ֤שֶׂם נְצִיבִ֔ים בֶּֽאֱדוֹם֙ כָל־ אֱד֖וֹם וַיִּהְי֥וּ עֲבָדִ֣ים לְדָוִ֑יד יְהוָה֙ אֶת־ דָּוִ֔יד וַיּ֤וֹשַׁע בְּכֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָלָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·śem nə·ṣî·ḇîm be·’ĕ·ḏō·wm ḵāl ’ĕ·ḏō·wm way·yih·yū ‘ă·ḇā·ḏîm lə·ḏā·wîḏ Yah·weh ’eṯ- dā·wîḏ way·yō·wō·ša‘ bə·ḵōl ’ă·šer hā·lāḵ
verses.literal: He placed garrisons in Edom and all the Edomites were subject to David So the LORD - made David victorious wherever - he went

verses.original: דָּוִ֖יד וַיִּמְלֹ֥ךְ עַל־ כָּל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיְהִ֗י עֹשֶׂ֛ה מִשְׁפָּ֥ט וּצְדָקָ֖ה לְכָל־ עַמּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: dā·wîḏ way·yim·lōḵ ‘al- kāl- yiś·rā·’êl way·hî ‘ō·śeh miš·pāṭ ū·ṣə·ḏā·qāh lə·ḵāl ‘am·mōw
verses.literal: Thus David reigned over all Israel and administered justice and righteousness for all his people

verses.original: וְיוֹאָ֥ב בֶּן־ צְרוּיָ֖ה עַל־ הַצָּבָ֑א וִיהוֹשָׁפָ֥ט בֶּן־ אֲחִיל֖וּד מַזְכִּֽיר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yō·w·’āḇ ben- ṣə·rū·yāh ‘al- haṣ·ṣā·ḇā wî·hō·wō·šā·p̄āṭ ben- ’ă·ḥî·lūḏ maz·kîr
verses.literal: Joab son of Zeruiah was over the army Jehoshaphat son of Ahilud [was] the recorder

verses.original: וְצָד֧וֹק בֶּן־ אֲחִיט֛וּב וַאֲבִימֶ֥לֶךְ בֶּן־ אֶבְיָתָ֖ר כֹּהֲנִ֑ים וְשַׁוְשָׁ֖א סוֹפֵֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ṣā·ḏō·wq ben- ’ă·ḥî·ṭūḇ wa·’ă·ḇî·me·leḵ ben- ’eḇ·yā·ṯār kō·hă·nîm wə·šaw·šā sō·w·p̄êr
verses.literal: Zadok son of Ahitub and Ahimelech son of Abiathar were priests Shavsha [was] the scribe

verses.original: וּבְנָיָ֙הוּ֙ בֶּן־ יְה֣וֹיָדָ֔ע עַל־ הַכְּרֵתִ֖י וְהַפְּלֵתִ֑י דָוִ֥יד וּבְנֵי־ הָרִאשֹׁנִ֖ים הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃פ לְיַ֥ד
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nā·yā·hū ben- yə·hō·w·yā·ḏā‘ ‘al- hak·kə·rê·ṯî wə·hap·pə·lê·ṯî ḏā·wîḏ ū·ḇə·nê- hā·ri·šō·nîm ham·me·leḵ lə·yaḏ
verses.literal: Benaiah son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and Pelethites and David’s sons were chief officials at the king’s side
